urlText: Liverpool Station Lift 3 between the concourse and Platform 2/3 is not available
content:
At Liverpool Station Lift 3 between the concourse and Platform 2/3 is temporarily out of service.

From Tuesday 8 October until 12 December 2024 the lift between the concourse and Platforms 2 and 3 will be closed for an upgrade.

Please use the ramp on the opposite end of the platform. For lift access, travel to Cabramatta from Platform 1 and change for trains towards the City.

If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 9765 1655.

urlText: L1 John Street Square lift out of service
content:
The lift on the John Street Square light rail platform towards Dulwich Hill is temporarily out of service until further notice.
 
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
Use the stairs,
·        Or use the lift on the opposite platform
 
For urgent assistance:
Use the Help Point if on the platform
·        Or call 131 500
